meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 可使用 COBRApy 库分析细胞代谢模型:加载或构建模型,进行通量平衡分析(FBA)、通量变异分析(FVA)、基因敲除、通量采样、最小培养基计算、模型补全等,并给出数值结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求做代谢建模分析时触发,例如:加载或构建代谢模型、运行 FBA/FVA 模拟、模拟基因敲除、计算最小培养基等。

say.text: 加载 iJO1366 模型,预测大肠杆菌的生长速率
say.note: 运行 FBA,输出生长速率数值

say.text: 对教科书模型做单基因敲除筛选,找出必需基因
say.note: 返回每个基因敲除后的生长情况

say.text: 用教科书模型计算最小培养基
say.note: 输出最少组分的培养基配方

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use the COBRApy library to analyze cellular metabolic models: load or build models, run flux balance analysis (FBA), flux variability analysis (FVA), gene knockouts, flux sampling, minimal medium computation, and gap filling, returning numerical results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests metabolic modeling tasks, such as loading or building a metabolic model, running FBA/FVA simulations, gene knockout screening, or computing minimal media.

say_en.text: Load the iJO1366 model and predict the growth rate of E. coli.
say_en.note: Runs FBA and returns the growth rate.

say_en.text: Run single-gene deletion screening on the textbook model to find essential genes.
Compute a minimal medium for the textbook model.
say_en.note: Outputs the medium with fewest components.
